pages.title: PI jobs, commands and replay

workflow: Select the correct plant and authorized scope.
Create and start — Starts a durable job; duplicate active scope returns JOB_SCOPE_EXISTS.
Start / Pause / Resume / Drain / Stop — Changes state and records transition; current page commits before pause/stop.

logic: Unit version takes precedence; otherwise whole-plant version applies.
Approval rejects stale drafts (STALE_DRAFT) and self-approval (SEPARATION_OF_DUTIES).
Already calculated periods retain their recorded policy version until recalculated.
Cross-boundary records must account for stock change; a known but uncompensated record is not a valid substitute.
setup: Agree production measurement boundaries and candidate streams.
Commission signal definitions and unit bindings.
Draft ranked primary/redundant/reconciled/manual choices with evidence.
Obtain independent approval before relying on fallback output.
